summary: FM-FAM is a DFAM-style percussion synth with a 16-step sequencer, a two-oscillator synth voice and a separate kick voice with its own sequence. Beta.
features: Two oscillators with 16 wave types, filter, noise and envelopes
Kick voice with its own 16-step sequencer, FM and noise
Virtual patch bay with eight cables
176 patterns with a sound each, a 32-slot song, parameter locks
Effects chain: compressor, delay, reverb, stutter, DJ filter, limiter
Randomise or reset any page; MIDI clock in and out, pulse sync out
